title: Converging Measures and an Emergent Model: A Meta-Analysis of Human-Automation Trust Questionnaires
reasoning: The paper extensively discusses 'Structural Trust' as a key component of human-automation trust, defining it as the belief that the trustee (automation) will abide by 'cultural and behavioral norms, morals, agreements, and laws.' It further elaborates on concepts like 'integrity, responsibility, honor, and shame' within Structural Trust. The paper also discusses how 'ethics and integrity are relevant to specific robotics applications' and mentions assumptions about robots being 'fair and ethical'. This goes beyond a brief ethical considerations section, integrating moral and ethical considerations into the core trust model being evaluated.
